_meta.description: Topical authority clusters for Vibration of Awesome. Each cluster is a semantic territory the site is building authority in. Posts belong to one primary cluster and optionally reference related clusters. Used for internal linking, content strategy, and future demand-signal feedback.
_meta.usage: Assign posts a 'cluster' field matching a cluster key. Future internal-link suggestions will surface related posts within the same cluster.
